edges.description: Reduced ColGalT1 lowers COL4A1 secretion, and wild-type but not mutant COLGALT1 restores COL4A1 production. Hypogalactosylation of collagen IV has been inferred in mouse fibroblasts but not measured in patient material.
edges.target: Impaired Collagen IV Production and Secretion

edges.description: A deficit of collagen IV, the main structural collagen of vascular basement membranes, is proposed to weaken cerebral small vessels as in COL4A1 and COL4A2 disease. Vessel-wall pathology has not been examined in a COLGALT1 patient.
edges.source: Impaired Collagen IV Production and Secretion
edges.target: Cerebral Small Vessel Basement Membrane Fragility

edges.description: Fragile small vessels rupture, giving parenchymal and periventricular hemorrhage.
edges.source: Cerebral Small Vessel Basement Membrane Fragility

edges.description: Small deep infarcts are a feature of the small vessel disease shared with COL4A1 and COL4A2 disease; the COLGALT1-specific route to ischemia is not established.
edges.source: Cerebral Small Vessel Basement Membrane Fragility

edges.description: Confluent white matter disease is part of the small vessel phenotype; its mechanism in COLGALT1 disease is not established.
edges.source: Cerebral Small Vessel Basement Membrane Fragility

edges.description: Perinatal hemorrhage is followed by porencephalic cavities.
Deep parenchymal hemorrhage extends into the ventricles.
Intraventricular blood obstructs cerebrospinal fluid flow.
Epilepsy is a recognized consequence of porencephaly; the link is taken from collagen IV porencephaly generally, not shown specifically for COLGALT1 disease.
A lacunar infarct in the right corona radiata produced left-sided weakness.

edges.source: Neurosurgical Management of Hemorrhage and Hydrocephalus

edges.limitations: Mutant fibroblasts show more, not less, collagen IV in the medium, with degradation products, unlike the reduced COL4A1 secretion seen in human knockdown cells. Brain vessels and cerebral hemorrhage were not characterized, and homozygotes do not survive birth.

nodes.description: Biallelic COLGALT1 variants reduce or abolish ColGalT1, the endoplasmic reticulum galactosyltransferase that transfers galactose to hydroxylysine residues of collagens before triple-helix formation. Structural modelling predicts that the p.Leu151Arg and p.Ala154Pro missense variants destabilize folding, and patient 1 of the founding report had no detectable ColGalT1 protein or activity. The c.625-2A>C splice variant mainly produces a frameshifted transcript subject to nonsense-mediated decay.

nodes.description: Without adequate ColGalT1 activity, cells produce and secrete less of the collagen IV alpha1 chain. In Colgalt1 mutant mouse embryonic fibroblasts collagen IV instead accumulates inside cells and in the matrix with a lower molecular mass and signs of degradation, so the human and mouse cell systems disagree on secretion but agree that collagen IV processing and stability depend on COLGALT1.
